purpose: Phase-1 control for eliminating every material dependency on primary Work mode by producing tested scheduled-Chat-native outcome routes that remain usable with zero external monthly free-tier/credit quota and zero incremental monetary cost, while leaving the authoritative primary execution unchanged.
authoritative_for: portfolio membership/allocation, method optimization, scheduler reconciliation, Work-dependency elimination matrix, zero-quota sustainability gates and root acceptance; role configs remain substantive role authority
supersedes: O_CHAT_PARALLEL control7 wherever control7 allowed an irreducible Work/protected-primary handoff to count as a solved route or allowed finite monthly/free-tier quota features in an accepted critical path

non_regression.rule: All control7 pool, safety, CLEAN-isolation, continuation, anti-stop, scheduler, evidence, conflict, authority and Phase-2 transition rules remain mandatory except where this control strengthens Phase-1 by forbidding residual Work dependencies and finite-quota solution paths.

phase.name: phase_1_chat_parity
phase.root_problem: For every material outcome currently obtained only because the unchanged primary runs in Work mode, eliminate that Work-mode dependency itself. Design, implement and test an outcome-equivalent route executable by the existing scheduled Chat-mode pool using only Chat-exposed capabilities and note-mediated control/state. Do not solve the problem by labeling any remainder irreducible, by handing execution back to Work or the protected primary, by requiring a user action, or by depending on any GitHub/cloud/external feature whose monthly free allowance, trial credit, paid credit or hosted-compute quota can be exhausted.
phase.authority_rule: Do not copy or violate protected primary authority. Instead redesign the route so the useful outcome no longer requires that protected transition. If a route still contains a Work/protected-primary/user-only execution step, that matrix row and its parent remain unresolved and must be decomposed or replaced.
phase.acceptance_criterion: All 19 intended roles are active and assignment-bound; the Work-dependency-elimination matrix covers every identified Work-only outcome; every row has a tested Chat-native route with zero residual Work/protected-primary/user execution steps, zero finite-monthly-quota dependency and zero incremental monetary cost; zero-quota replay/fault controls and all role/bootstrap/conflict/authority/usefulness gates pass.
phase.on_acceptance: Persist proof and immediately compute the Phase-2 full-pool portfolio minimizing expected elapsed time to the unchanged primary O objective; no blanket restoration interval.

resource_sustainability.critical_path_rule: An accepted route must still function when every optional monthly free-tier, trial-credit, paid-credit, hosted-compute and artifact quota is set to zero.
forbidden_as_solution_or_acceptance_evid: GitHub Actions hosted-runner minutes or Actions-dependent compute
GitHub Packages, Actions artifacts, LFS or other quota-metered storage/transfer
paid or trial cloud compute, serverless functions or build minutes
paid or trial external API/model credits
any monthly free tier whose exhaustion stops the route
manual user execution used to bridge a missing Chat capability
resource_sustainability.ordinary_repository_transport: Normal Git contents/ref/issue/PR API operations may be used only as lightweight transport/state operations. The route must tolerate per-window rate limiting through checkpoint/backoff and may not substitute high API volume for compute.
resource_sustainability.default_experiment_policy: Do not consume quota-bearing features even for experiments unless the user explicitly authorizes that feature. Existing historical evidence from such a feature may inform hypotheses but cannot by itself prove an accepted route.
required_tests: zero_monthly_quota replay: all forbidden quota surfaces unavailable
steady-state continuation across multiple scheduled Chat invocations

fallback.use_only_when: a SHA-only refs/heads/main lookup is not exposed in the scheduled Chat connector
fallback.pass_1: fetch every role-approved authoritative path and record exact returned Git blob SHA plus parsed revision; consume no other semantic input
fallback.pass_2: immediately before first role-local/public semantic read, fetch the same authoritative paths again in the same order
fallback.valid_when: all path/blob/revision tuples and cross-control references are identical, no forbidden semantic input was consumed, and no own-state CAS/input conflict exists
fallback.freeze: freeze verified path/blob/revision tuple and record transport_mode=exact_blob_two_pass
fallback.post_freeze: unrelated main movement is not a stop; later checks compare only frozen authority paths/blobs
fallback.failure: write diagnostic checkpoint and exact continuation, keep recurring task enabled, retry next invocation; never self-disable
fallback.aba_guard: monotonic control/config revisions and cross-file references must agree; rollback or mismatch is fail-closed

intended_pool.selection_rule: Use all 19 intended existing roles. Do not disable, pause, delete, replace or reduce the pool. work_delegation_gate remains standby only because the 19 roles plus protected monitor fill the 20-active-task cap and its bounded function has an optimizer fallback.

method_optimization.source: complete J-style recursive problem-solving loop adapted to scheduled Chat; J AGI objective excluded
required: forecast the problem tree and expected completion time
audit every unresolved leaf and unaudited ancestor for existing zero-cost zero-quota Chat solutions
attempt a direct Chat-native solution before decomposition
decompose every residual Work/protected-primary/user step into new unresolved children rather than accepting a handoff
decompose only into children whose integration eliminates the parent dependency
evaluate evidence and integrate children upward

when actual problem count exceeds forecast generate multiple transversal solutions that can remove several Work dependencies at once, replace obsolete branches while preserving evidence, and reforecast
when elapsed-time/progress exceeds forecast or assumptions fail generate alternative methods and switch only when expected time-to-root improves
optimize problem representation, method, verification, worker combination, sequential-versus-parallel execution, integration path, resource use and switching threshold, not merely role assignment
treat a finite-quota or paid route as an unaccepted prototype and continue searching for a quota-independent route
distinguish observations, inferences and unverified claims; fail closed on unsupported completion

phase_1_plan.direct_attempt: Inventory Work-only outcomes, then prove the smallest zero-cost, zero-monthly-quota Chat-native route for each outcome family before adding research branches.
route_matrix_columns: current Work dependency and why it exists
phase_1_plan.row_status_rule: A row is solved only when residual execution steps are empty, finite-monthly-quota dependency count is zero, incremental cost is zero and zero-quota replay passes. An exact unavailable-capability record creates an unresolved child; it is not a passing result.
phase_1_plan.overrun_trigger: Any intended role disabled after one reconciliation opportunity; no assignment-bound evidence after two enabled invocations; no substantive progress twice; matrix/checker controls disagree; any proposed route retains a Work/protected-primary/user step or quota-bearing critical-path feature; or measured critical path materially exceeds forecast.
phase_1_plan.overrun_action: Generate and compare alternative transport, architecture, method, decomposition, verification and allocation plans; use transversal redesign to eliminate whole dependency families; switch only when expected completion time improves.

per_role_required: current assignment bound through authoritative note control
all Chat-capable work for the selected leaf executed
an unavailable capability is converted into an unresolved child plus alternative-route search, never a pass
durable source-qualified evidence and exact continuation persisted
no accepted residual Work, protected-primary or user execution step
no accepted finite-monthly-quota or paid-credit dependency
negative_controls: A route with one Work/protected-primary/user step must fail.
A route that depends on GitHub Actions/Codespaces/artifact/LFS/package quota or any paid/trial credit must fail with all such quotas set to zero.
A route that only records unavailable capability without a replacement search must fail.
A route that succeeds once but cannot resume after rate limiting or invocation boundary must fail.

coordinators.integrator: maintains the 19-cell acceptance matrix, recursive problem tree and Work-dependency-elimination matrix while preserving existing index/feed safety
coordinators.automation_optimizer: independently rederives role cells, matrix, zero-quota controls, allocation and physical reconciliation; never becomes primary writer
coordinators.evidence_comparator: independently recomputes residual-dependency, quota/cost, conflict, authority and usefulness gates
coordinators.bridge: owns elimination of purported Work/protected-primary handoffs; residuals are blockers/problem-tree leaves, not accepted packages

acceptance.closure_rule: Missing, stale, bootstrap-invalid, mirror-only or unsupported evidence is not a pass. Any residual Work/protected-primary/user step or finite-monthly-quota/paid dependency keeps Phase 1 open. Integrator and optimizer must independently derive closure.

base_restoration: Preserve every original role, continuation, anti-stop/recovery, CLEAN boundary, provenance and CAS/readback contract as fallback metadata. During Phase 1 no role returns to unrelated base work. After Phase 1 base work is only a candidate in the Phase-2 optimum.

optimizer.phase_1_goal: Minimize expected elapsed time until every material Work-mode-only outcome has a tested zero-cost, zero-monthly-quota Chat-native route with no residual Work/protected-primary/user execution step.
optimizer.phase_2_goal: After Phase 1, minimize expected elapsed time to the unchanged primary O objective using the full then-enabled pool.
optimizer.next_action: Synchronize DESIRED_STATE and DOWNSTREAM_STATE to control8; replace all handoff-acceptance language with dependency-elimination language; build the zero-quota Work-dependency matrix; assign bridge/repro/evidence/integrator/clean roles to eliminate residuals; run negative controls; keep Phase 1 open until residual and quota dependency counts are zero.

migration.reason: The user clarified that the problem is to eliminate the Work/protected-primary dependency itself, not to classify a remainder as irreducible, and that a route relying on exhaustible GitHub monthly free-tier or other quota/credit features must not count as solved.
migration.rollback_condition: Only independently proven safety, authority, CLEAN-isolation or evidence-integrity failure. Never roll back by accepting a residual Work/protected-primary/user handoff or finite monthly quota dependency.
